title: Learning record v1 (06-EXPANSION §3.3)
description: One record per steer→outcome pair, at one of two fidelities. The factual fields are derived from the record (harness queue, git, job tree), never authored; mental_model is the author's claim and is labelled as such. Comprehension state is NOT in this record (06-EXPANSION §3.4).

fidelity.description: iterative = a harness lesson; exploratory = a research-branch delta. A registry (06-EXPANSION §1): later fidelities are added, never switched on in code.

source_ref.description: Where the factual fields were derived from.

merge_range.description: base..head of the merged worktree, or empty when parked

domains.description: topic tags; hubs stay emergent (D1), tags are only search handles

steer.description: iterative: the anchor's goal + acceptance; exploratory: the question or steer that opened the branch

red.description: iterative: what the failing state looked like (repro, test output); exploratory: the gap as stated

iterations.description: iterative only: returns from tester or reviewer before green

evidence.description: commit, test output path, or claim id
commits, test outputs, claim ids with their credibility and coverage

deviation.description: the delta between steer and outcome, read in retrospect; exploratory: whether a human steer or a gap steer answered the gap (D3)

mental_model.description: AUTHORED. The abstraction that would have skipped the iterations. Labelled as the worker's claim; never treated as fact.

skill_candidate.description: Shared raw material for the agent-org / harness pillar. The research tooling stores it and never interprets or acts on it (06-EXPANSION §3.1).

reviewer_check.description: iterative only: the reviewer verified outcome.summary against the merge range before merging.
